basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Junior Engineer (Electrical) is on 26 November 2026, with reporting from 10:30 A.M. to 12:30 P.M. at H.R.D. Department, Outsourcing Cell, 4th floor, Service Block Building, Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr. E. Borges Road, Parel, Mumbai – 400012. M/s. A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., a private outsourcing agency, is engaging the Junior Engineer (Electrical) on contract basis, initially for two years, at Rs. 40,000/- per month.

age_limit.details: Should not exceed 40 years at the time of interview. The notice prints no age relaxation.

qualification.details: The notice invites applications for one post, Junior Engineer (Electrical), on contract basis initially for a period of two years. | First Class Diploma from Institutes approved by State Board of Technical Examination, or Degree in Electrical Engineering from Institutes approved by AICTE. | 3 years post qualification experience with an established firm in execution or maintenance of electrical installations such as the following, in a hospital, institutional or commercial complex, or in industrial maintenance works: | HT / LT Sub-station and Switchgear ACB, MCCB, Starter, Cubical Panels DG Set, APFC Building wiring / cabling Fire alarm and Public Address System CCTV, Elevators etc. | Should not exceed 40 years at the time of interview. The notice prints no age relaxation. | Remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- per month. The job location is Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr. Ernest Borges Road, Parel, Mumbai – 400012. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility details.

important_instructions: All outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. The engagement is on contract basis, initially for a period of two years. The notice does not mention any travel allowance for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: A-1 Facility and Property Managers Junior Engineer (Electrical) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: H.R.D. Department, Outsourcing Cell, 4th floor, Service Block Building, Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr. E. Borges Road, Parel, Mumbai – 400012
Eligible candidates with a First Class Diploma or a Degree in Electrical Engineering, 3 years' experience, and age not exceeding 40 years at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: About A-1 Facility and Property Managers
content_sections.text: M/s. A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai, describes itself as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to Tata Memorial Hospital on contract basis. The advertised post is for its client, Tata Memorial Hospital, at Parel, Mumbai. This is a private agency's contract job, not a direct hospital appointment.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one post, Junior Engineer (Electrical), on contract basis initially for a period of two years. First Class Diploma from Institutes approved by State Board of Technical Examination, or Degree in Electrical Engineering from Institutes approved by AICTE. 3 years post qualification experience with an established firm in execution or maintenance of electrical installations such as the following, in a hospital, institutional or commercial complex, or in industrial maintenance works: HT / LT Sub-station and Switchgear ACB, MCCB, Starter, Cubical Panels DG Set, APFC Building wiring / cabling Fire alarm and Public Address System CCTV, Elevators etc. Should not exceed 40 years at the time of interview. The notice prints no age relaxation. Remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- per month. The job location is Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr. Ernest Borges Road, Parel, Mumbai – 400012. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Updated Resume Passport size Photograph Xerox copies of Aadhaar card and PAN card Xerox copies of Educational Certificates Xerox copies of Experience Certificates

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates attend the interview at the venue above. If more candidates attend, an MCQ Test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview accordingly. The notice does not describe the MCQ test pattern or marks.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. The engagement is on contract basis, initially for a period of two years. The notice does not mention any travel allowance for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Junior Engineer (Electrical)?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Candidates may report between 10:30 A.M. and 12:30 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview held?
faq.answer: At H.R.D. Department, Outsourcing Cell, 4th floor, Service Block Building, Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr. E. Borges Road, Parel, Mumbai – 400012.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A First Class Diploma from Institutes approved by State Board of Technical Examination, or a Degree in Electrical Engineering from Institutes approved by AICTE, plus 3 years post qualification experience with an established firm.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age should not exceed 40 years at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry an updated Resume, a passport size photograph, and xerox copies of Aadhaar card, PAN card, Educational Certificates and Experience Certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: If more candidates attend, an MCQ Test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview accordingly.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract basis, initially for a period of two years, through the outsourcing agency M/s. A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd.

faq.question: Q10. Will accommodation be provided to outstation candidates?
faq.answer: No. The notice says accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.
